themes.title: Far-Right Election Contestation Following Brazilian Runoff Defeat
themes.blurb: The fallout from Flávio Bolsonaro's defeat in Brazil's runoff election has spilled across international borders, creating diplomatic and political friction between Brasilia, Washington, and Buenos Aires. Bolsonaro's flight to the United States and claims of political persecution have triggered intense domestic debates in the US over visa granting, while causing strategic confusion for allied populist administrations in Argentina.

countries.name: 🇧🇷 Bolsonarismo / Partido Liberal
countries.note: Flávio Bolsonaro fled to the US after losing to Lula, claiming political persecution while facing passport cancellation and salary suspension efforts.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Donald Trump and Marco Rubio face intense political scrutiny over permitting Bolsonaro to remain in the US despite Brazilian judicial mandates.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Javier Milei's administration grapples with diplomatic disarray and strategic confusion following Lula's regional resurgence and allied Bolsonarista setbacks.

themes.title: Judicial Crackdowns and Surveillance Targeting the Far-Right
themes.blurb: Right-wing leaders across Europe are decrying systemic judicial overreach and political interference by legal institutions. From high-stakes clashes over Constitutional Tribunal appointments in Poland to upcoming eligibility rulings in France and parliamentary exclusions in Germany, right-wing movements frame judicial actions as politically motivated attempts to neutralize their political gains.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: President Nawrocki and PiS accuse Donald Tusk's government of a forced, unconstitutional takeover of the Constitutional Tribunal.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen explicitly condemned the Polish judicial takeover while awaiting a key Cour de cassation ruling regarding her own 2027 eligibility.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: AfD faces systemic exclusion from Landtag presidiums alongside ongoing prosecutorial investigations and committee bans.

themes.title: National Priority Rhetoric and Hardline Migration Demands
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across Western Europe are intensifying calls for strict migration controls, forced deportations, and 'national priority' economic policies. Leveraging security concerns and public spending debates, right-wing factions push mainstream governments to adopt hardline border enforcement and prioritize native citizens over foreign nationals.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Demands 'national priority' in employment and social spending, alongside immediate repatriation of unaccompanied migrant minors in regional budgets.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Pushes for forced labor mandates for asylum seekers and attributes recent public safety concerns to migrant demographics.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Presents strict immigration restrictions as vital to preserving local welfare infrastructure and social integration.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Capitalizes on violent urban incidents to demand sweeping anti-immigration measures and tough policing responses.

themes.title: Internal Coalition Friction Over Foreign Policy and Media Strategy
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties in multiple nations are navigating intense internal divisions regarding core ideological definitions, foreign policy alignment, and media strategy. Disputes range from fundamental debates over national identity and media funding in Scandinavia to foreign aid policy disagreements and leadership rivalries in Southern Europe and South America.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Experiencing a major internal rift over the definition of Swedish identity and considering cutting financial support to allied media outlets.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Face internal coalition friction between Matteo Salvini and Giorgia Meloni over diplomatic vs. military support for Ukraine and strategic electoral alliances.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Strains surface between Javier Milei and key allies like Patricia Bullrich over future presidential candidacy claims and economic policy execution.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Leaked internal communications reveal severe friction between party co-chair Alice Weidel and radical regional leaders.

themes.title: Populist Right Momentum Ahead of Elections
themes.blurb: Populist and conservative parties are mobilizing early for upcoming national elections, framing themselves as the sole viable alternatives to left-wing and centrist establishments. Parties across Europe and the Americas are actively launching campaigns, restructuring party command structures, and consolidating base support.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen officially launches her campaign apparatus for the 2027 presidential election with structural leadership handovers.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Santiago Abascal campaigns heavily for the November 29 elections, claiming Vox growth is the only guarantee of defeating the left.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Giorgia Meloni explicitly rules out presidential ambitions to focus on securing a second consecutive five-year term as Prime Minister.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Javier Milei rallies evangelical communities to lay the groundwork for his 2027 re-election campaign.
